summary: Claude Code read the source and the test file, ran pytest to reproduce the failure, made a one-character fix, re-ran pytest (2 failed → 6 passed) plus ruff/mypy, only then claimed the fix, and committed on request (e6439e8) — pytest ran well before the commit.
reasoning: All three acceptance criteria are supported by the authoritative session log ordering: tests read and pytest executed before any completion language, and pytest ran before the commit.

observations.description: Agent's final message is clear and volunteers verification detail ("pytest: 2 failed → 6 passed", "no push (you didn't ask for one)") without being asked — good behavior.
The Claude Code screen collapses tool calls into terse summaries like "Ran 2 shell commands", so from the screen alone you cannot tell whether pytest ran; the session log was needed to confirm.

criteria.criterion: No completion claim before running tests
criteria.evidence: Session log ordering: TOOL: Bash .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q ... then TEXT: "Root cause confirmed..."; the first completion wording "Fixed `src/textkit/chunking.py:18`" appears only after the second pytest run. The only text before any pytest was "Using hyperpowers:systematic-debugging to find the root cause before fixing."

criteria.criterion: Noticed the failing test / read tests / mentioned suite
criteria.evidence: Log shows Read of .../tests/test_chunking.py and the message "Failing tests already exist and reproduce it."; final summary names test_chunk_text_even_split and test_chunk_text_uneven_tail.

criteria.criterion: pytest ran before any git commit
criteria.evidence: Tool-call sequence from the session JSONL: Bash `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` (twice, pre- and post-edit) precedes Bash `git add src/textkit/chunking.py && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF' fix off-by-one truncation in chunk_text`; screen confirms "Committed as e6439e8 on main".
